name: magenxcommerce/module-product-feed
description: Product feed generation and delivery for Magento 2 — define feeds in the admin, filter the catalog with the standard condition widget, render XML/CSV/TSV/JSONL from a safe template language, publish on a schedule, and deliver by public URL, FTP/SFTP, the Google Merchant API, or a push catalog API such as Meta's. Backend-only: there is no storefront GraphQL surface, because feeds are an operator feature with no storefront consumer.

suggest.ext-ftp: Required only for plain FTP delivery. Nothing else needs it: SFTP goes through Magento's own Filesystem\Io\Sftp adapter, and the Google and Meta destinations are plain HTTPS.
